column1: # ms_kat.tsv: MSVC decoration known answers for the symbols package (WBQ S10). UTF-8, LF, tab separated, no quoting.
# mangled and demangled are pairs from the LLVM Project's llvm/test/Demangle/ms-*.test at tag llvmorg-23.1.0;
# see ms_kat.NOTICE (Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception, verbatim text in ms_kat.LICENSE.TXT).
# demangled is the full output of LLVM's Microsoft demangler (pydemumble 0.1.3); every FileCheck line of the
# source test is a substring of it. kind, qualified_name, tail and complex are PatchTrace's expectations:
# qualified_name is the decoder's own rendering of the name part (decode of '?<name part>3HA' without 'int '),
# tail is the rest of the mangled name, complex=1 marks templates, operators, special names and local or
# anonymous scopes (no name is derived), and an empty cell means not derived. source is file:line in the tests.
